geometry_encoding: Analytic Point, EmptyPoint, LineString, Box, and Polygon specifications; scalar buffers use Shapely default quad_segs=16.

numeric_tolerances.near_boundary_justification: 1e-7 m is more than six orders above observed double/GEOS edge noise (about 1e-14 m) while remaining negligible against the 15-315 m methodology distances.

live_contract_mapping.weighted_time_columns: The scalar scorer calculates one building result (near-edge footprint buffers/distances) and copies it unchanged to 5min, 10min, and 15min columns; it does not consume per-minute service-count columns.
live_contract_mapping.street_light_tiers: Raw local union area divided by the scalar 300 m near-edge buffer area: >50 percent gives 100; 30 through 50 inclusive gives 50; below 30 gives 0. There is no separate light rounding or capping step.
live_contract_mapping.park_semantics: Any intersecting source park gives 50; any one intersecting source geometry with full source area >=3000 m2 gives 100. Counts and overlapping areas are not aggregated.
live_contract_mapping.shade_semantics: Each sanitized source-surface intersection contributes independently and in scalar spatial-index query order; overlaps are intentionally counted once per source row before one-decimal half-up storage.

traversal_runtime_characterization: Captured on Python 3.13.4, GeoPandas 1.1.3, Shapely 2.1.2, GEOS 3.13.1, and pandas 3.0.2. STRtree/sindex candidate emission order is runtime-sensitive; the literal order-sensitive shade cases characterize this exact capture runtime and must not be silently re-sorted.

One float above 30 raw percent remains in the middle tier.

shade_weighting.description: No shade surfaces returns raw and stored zero.
An empty point is skipped and returns zero without exception.
A valid surface outside 300 m contributes nothing.
Identical street/open-space surfaces are both area-weighted, so overlap is double-accounted by source row.
Source order 0,1,2 is queried as 1,2,0 and ordinary float additions follow that traversal.
The runtime query order [1,2,0] accumulates a raw mean 1.11e-16 below 0.35 and stores 0.3; source order [0,1,2] yields exactly 0.35 and would store 0.4.
Invalid bowtie polygon is repaired to 800 m2 of polygonal parts before weighting.
A surface crossing the 300 m edge contributes only its exact scalar-buffer intersection area.
A non-finite score row and a line geometry are dropped; the finite polygon remains.
Raw area-weighted 0.15 remains available from lookup while building storage rounds half-up to 0.2.
